title: Pullback-counit identity on resolution cocycles
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $J$ its Zariski topology [def-sc-zariski-site], $K$ its small etale topology [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $i:X.\mathrm{Opens}\to X.\mathrm{Etale}$ continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume abelian sheafification and Ext on both sites, and that $L=i^{-1}$ is additive and preserves finite limits. Let $f^p_V:H^p(V,A)\to H^p(i(V),LA)$ be a family natural in the coefficient $A$, commuting with the Yoneda-product connecting maps for every short exact sequence and its image under $L$, and equal in degree zero to evaluation of the adjunction unit as in [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback]. Write $G=i_*$. Let $F$ be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $R$ an injective resolution of $GF$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and $b:R\to GI$ a cochain map with $b^0\iota_R=G\iota_I$. Fix $q\ge0$ and $V\in X.\mathrm{Opens}$. Let $P(W)$ be the sheafification of the free abelian representable on an object $W$. If $a:P(V)\to R^q$ and $c:P(i(V))\to I^q$ are cocycles and evaluation at the identity generator of $c$ equals $b^q(V)$ applied to the identity-generator section of $a$, then $H^q(\epsilon_F)f^q_V([a])=[c]$ in $H^q(i(V),F)$, where $\epsilon_F:LGF\to F$ is the counit and the classes are computed using $R$ and $I$. No section-homology equivalence is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Resolve an arbitrary A and LA. Since L is an additive left adjoint preserving finite limits, it is exact, so G preserves injectives. Extend the unit augmentation into the pushed resolution degree by degree, using injectivity and exactness of the source. Differences of two extensions factor through the differentials and extend into the next injective term; hence the extensions are homotopic.

The section maps induced by these unit comparisons are natural in A, because lifts of coefficient morphisms commute up to homotopy. The horseshoe construction makes them commute with the connecting maps, and their degree-zero value is the unit evaluated at the identity generator. Positive Ext with P(V) fixed is effaceable in the coefficient variable by embedding the coefficient into an injective. Use surjective connecting maps and induction on degree to conclude that the characterized family fstar is this family. The connecting class is the Yoneda product with the extension class, as in the site pullback theorem.

Take A=GF and postcompose the unit comparison with a comparison lifting the counit into I. The triangle identity gives the pushed augmentation of I. The homotopy argument for equally augmented comparisons identifies this composite with b on section cocycle classes. By hsec the image of the section of a is the section of c; the free-representable adjunction is bijective, so this is exactly c. Computing the coefficient counit map on Ext gives H(counit) fstar([a]) = [c]. In degree zero there are no incoming boundaries; the same adjunction computations cover zero sheaves and empty V.

    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]

      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)]
    (fstar : ∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
      (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      Sheaf.H' A p V ⟶

          (op V) ≫

          fstar p V A ≫
            ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology p).map
              ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map φ)).app
                  (op (i.obj V))) ∧
      (∀ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (hS : S.ShortExact)
        (hS' : (S.map (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)).ShortExact)

            (((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x).hom.app (op V)).hom
              (((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op V)).hom
                  (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V))))))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F))
    (b : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (hb : R.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map (I.ι.f 0))
    (q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
    (a : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶ R.cocomplex.X q)
    (ha : a ≫ R.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (c : (presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj

    (hc : c ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)

            (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op V)).hom
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V)))) =

            (yoneda.obj (i.obj V) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op (i.obj V))).hom
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 (i.obj V)))))) :

            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology q).map

            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).counit.app F)).app
